profile.name: HP 8657A 射频信号发生器
profile.description: HP 8657A 是一款射频信号发生器，可在约 100 kHz 到 1040 MHz 范围内输出频率与幅度可调的射频信号，并支持基本调制功能。它常用于通信与电子实验中的器件测试、接收机校准、信号链路调试和一般射频测量。
profile.description_en: The HP 8657A is an RF signal generator that provides frequency- and amplitude-adjustable RF output over approximately 100 kHz to 1040 MHz, with basic modulation capability. It is commonly used for device testing, receiver calibration, signal-chain troubleshooting, and general RF measurements in communications and electronics labs.
